name: Docker-Only Cleanup
description:
Implementation plan: docs/plans/2026-02-04-docker-only-cleanup.md

Remove Modal, Fly, and Local PTY code. Simplify codebase to Docker-only sandbox mode.

name: Rebuild sandbox image and test end-to-end
description: 1. docker build -t claude-game-sandbox:latest -f sandbox/Dockerfile . 2. Start backend: SANDBOX_MODE=docker uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 3. Start frontend: npm run dev 4. Open localhost:5173, start a lesson, verify iframe loads ttyd terminal and shell works.
result: Docker image rebuilt. Backend starts on 8080 in Docker mode. Session creation works, ttyd returns HTTP 200 on mapped port without auth. Full flow verified via curl.

name: Bind Docker ports to localhost only
description: In backend/app/services/docker_sandbox.py line 96, change ports={"7681/tcp": self.port} to ports={"7681/tcp": ("127.0.0.1", self.port)}. This ensures ttyd is only reachable from localhost, replacing ttyd auth as the security boundary.
result: Port mapping now binds to 127.0.0.1 only. Verified import works.

name: Task 1-6: Delete backend/spike/cloud files
description: Delete non-Docker service files, API files, test/script files, spike directory, untracked cloud files, and planning docs

name: Remove ttyd auth from sandbox entrypoint
description: Remove -c "user:${TTYD_TOKEN}" flag from sandbox/entrypoint.sh line 17. Change to: exec ttyd -p 7681 bash -l. Port is localhost-only so auth is unnecessary and breaks iframe loading in browsers.
result: Removed -c auth flag and TTYD_TOKEN reference from entrypoint.sh

name: Task 20-23: Test and finalize
description: Test backend startup, frontend build, end-to-end test, final commit

name: Task 14-19: Simplify frontend
description: Simplify config.ts, App.tsx, Terminal.tsx, useVerificationProgress.ts, remove xterm deps, update .env.example

name: Fix IframeTerminal URL construction
description: In frontend/src/components/Terminal.tsx lines 35-38, change Docker-mode URL from http://user:${ttydToken}@localhost:${ttydPort}/ to http://localhost:${ttydPort}/. Browsers block credentials in iframe URLs. Remove ttydToken from URL logic (keep prop for backward compat).
result: Removed credentials from iframe URL, now uses http://localhost:{port}/ directly. tsc --noEmit passes.

name: Task 7-13: Fix backend imports and config
description: Fix __init__.py files, simplify config.py, main.py, .gitignore, pyproject.toml, .env.example

name: Remove dead WebSocket proxy from docker_terminal.py
description: Delete the entire /ws/docker/terminal/{session_id} WebSocket endpoint (lines 113-207) from backend/app/api/docker_terminal.py. Remove unused imports: asyncio, json, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, websockets, ConnectionClosed. Change terminal_url in responses from ws:// to http:// (iframe, not WebSocket). Keep REST endpoints only.
result: Removed WebSocket proxy endpoint, unused imports (asyncio, json, WebSocket, websockets). Changed terminal_url to http://. File went from 207 to 107 lines.
